data.narrative:
Drafter is a Seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company founded by Chris Barton and Peter Atkin that has raised $3M+. The valuation analysis draws from a sector universe of 9 private peers and 1 public comparable, including Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, and Bedrock Robotics.

Stage-progression analysis is the primary applicable method given data constraints. Using total raised ($3M) as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage progression yields an implied valuation of $8M. This method reflects expected value creation between rounds absent sufficient narrow peer trading multiples.

Peer-median analysis was not applicable. While 8 robotics and manufacturing peers exist, the filtered peer set (same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-valuation-tier comps) contained insufficient density to support a reliable median. Applying an all-sector median would introduce unacceptable methodological bias.

The triangulated valuation range is $6M to $9M, with a median point of $8M supported by stage-progression mechanics. This range reflects Seed-stage capital deployed and typical progression expectations within the robotics sector. Key uncertainties include the absence of granular peer trading data at this stage, capital efficiency relative to sector benchmarks, and actual product-market traction metrics beyond total raised.
